meta.inclusion_rule: Complete coverage on every Giga v1 input, then the top 48 economies under equal-weight Power Now.

power.label: Global Power Rankings
power.question: How much observable economic weight can each country mobilise now?
power.method: Five observable pillars are standardised within the fixed 48-economy cohort and equally weighted by default.

potential.label: Global Power Potential Rankings
potential.question: Which present conditions could expand or erode economic power?
potential.method: Observed 2015–2024 conditions and latest structural measures are standardised within the same cohort; no projection enters the score.

domestic_market.label: Domestic market
domestic_market.description: Economic scale, household purchasing power and market-rate weight.

productive_base.label: Productive base
productive_base.description: The scale and intensity of industry already in place.

trade_power.label: Trade power
trade_power.description: Export reach, import pull and breadth across trade partners.

financial_buffer.label: Financial buffer
financial_buffer.description: External liquidity, import cover and the observed current-account position.

population_base.label: Population base
population_base.description: Total, working-age and urban human scale available to mobilise.

momentum.label: Growth momentum
momentum.description: Decade growth, recent growth and per-person growth already observed.

reinvestment.label: Reinvestment
reinvestment.description: Investment, domestic savings and foreign capital formation.

demographic_runway.label: Demographic runway
demographic_runway.description: Working-age capacity, youth pipeline and population momentum.

conversion_capacity.label: Conversion capacity
conversion_capacity.description: Institutions and digital infrastructure that turn assets into output.

productive_depth.label: Productive depth
productive_depth.description: Manufacturing intensity, export complexity and product diversity.

macro_resilience.label: Macro resilience
macro_resilience.description: Price stability, external balance and steadiness through the cycle.

resource_optionality.label: Resource optionality
resource_optionality.description: Current rents, export scale and diversity across extractive product groups.

household_consumption.label: Household consumption at purchasing power parity

reserve_import_cover.label: Reserve import coverage
reserve_import_cover.source: Derived from World Bank and Harvard Growth Lab Atlas

sources.name: Harvard Growth Lab Atlas of Economic Complexity
